project.name: walk-my-dog
project.description: An Angular 14 dog-walking management UI (components, services, routing) generated with Angular CLI, backed by an in-memory DogsService data store.

nodes.name: app-routing.module.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the Angular router configuration for the application, mapping routes to DogsListComponent and lazy-loading DogViewComponent for the details view.

nodes.name: AppRoutingModule
nodes.summary: Angular NgModule that configures and exports RouterModule with the application's route definitions.

nodes.name: app.component.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Unit test suite for AppComponent, verifying component creation, title property value, and rendered title in the DOM.

nodes.name: app.component.ts
nodes.summary: Root Angular component that renders the application shell with a top navigation bar and a router-outlet for child views.

nodes.name: AppComponent
nodes.summary: Root Angular component decorated with an inline template containing a navigation bar and router-outlet; holds the application title.

nodes.name: app.module.ts
nodes.summary: Root NgModule that declares AppComponent, imports BrowserModule and AppRoutingModule, and bootstraps the Angular application.

nodes.name: AppModule
nodes.summary: Root Angular NgModule that wires together the browser platform, routing, and the top-level AppComponent for bootstrapping.

nodes.name: environment.ts
nodes.summary: Development environment configuration object exporting a production flag set to false; replaced with environment.prod.ts during production builds.
nodes.languageNotes: Angular CLI file-replacement mechanism swaps this file for environment.prod.ts at build time via angular.json fileReplacements.

nodes.name: main.ts
nodes.summary: Application entry point that conditionally enables Angular's production mode and bootstraps the AppModule using the browser-dynamic platform.

nodes.name: dog-view.component.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Jasmine/TestBed unit test for DogViewComponent, containing a single smoke test that verifies the component can be created successfully.

nodes.name: dog-view.component.ts
nodes.summary: Standalone Angular component that reads a route index parameter and displays full details (photo, name, owner, description, location) for a single dog fetched from DogsService.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Angular standalone component API with inline template and styles; dog$ is an Observable resolved via the async pipe, driven by ActivatedRoute.paramMap.

nodes.name: dogs.service.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Jasmine/TestBed unit test for DogsService, containing a single smoke test that verifies the service can be injected and created successfully.

nodes.name: dogs.service.ts
nodes.summary: Root-provided Angular service that acts as an in-memory data store, exporting the Dog interface and a DogsService class holding a hardcoded array of six dog records with name, owner, description, photo URL, and location.
nodes.languageNotes: No HTTP calls or methods — data is entirely static. The Dog interface is co-located with the service rather than in a separate models file.

nodes.name: DogViewComponent
nodes.summary: Angular standalone component that resolves a dog by route index and exposes it as an Observable for async rendering of the detail view.

nodes.name: DogsService
nodes.summary: Injectable Angular service providing a static array of Dog records used as the application's data source for listing and viewing dogs.

nodes.name: dogs-list-card.component.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Unit test suite for DogsListCardComponent using Angular TestBed, verifying the card component renders and initializes correctly.

nodes.name: dogs-list-card.component.ts
nodes.summary: Angular component that renders a single dog card with an Input-bound dog object and index, consuming DogsService for dog data in the dogs list.

nodes.name: DogsListCardComponent
nodes.summary: Angular card component that accepts a dog and index as Input properties and initializes via DogsService in ngOnInit.

nodes.name: dogs-list.component.spec.ts
nodes.summary: Unit test suite for DogsListComponent using Angular TestBed, verifying the list component compiles and its basic behavior.

nodes.name: dogs-list.component.ts
nodes.summary: Angular component that fetches the full list of dogs from DogsService and renders them using DogsListCardComponent for each entry.

nodes.name: DogsListComponent
nodes.summary: Angular list component that injects DogsService and loads dogs on initialization for display via DogsListCardComponent.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Standard Angular CLI-generated project overview for WalkMyDog, covering development server, code scaffolding, build, unit test, and end-to-end test commands with links to Angular CLI reference documentation.

nodes.name: angular.json
nodes.summary: Angular CLI workspace configuration defining the walk-my-dog application's build, serve, test, and i18n-extract architect targets, including production/development build profiles with file replacement for environment switching and bundle size budgets.
nodes.languageNotes: Configures inline templates and inline styles for generated components (inlineTemplate/inlineStyle), which means all Angular components in this project embed their HTML and CSS directly in the .ts file rather than in separate files.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: NPM package manifest for the walk-my-dog Angular 14 application, declaring Angular framework dependencies, RxJS, and devDependencies for Angular CLI, TypeScript 4.7, and the Karma/Jasmine testing stack.

nodes.name: tsconfig.app.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the application build, extending the root tsconfig.json and scoping compilation to src/main.ts and src/polyfills.ts as entry points with no extra type definitions.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Root TypeScript configuration for the Angular 14 workspace enabling strict mode, ES2020 output target, experimental decorators for Angular metadata, and Angular-specific strict template and injection parameter checks.
nodes.languageNotes: Enables experimentalDecorators (required for Angular's @Component/@Injectable decorators), strictTemplates, and strictInjectionParameters — these Angular compiler options catch template and DI errors at compile time rather than at runtime.

nodes.name: tsconfig.spec.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the Karma/Jasmine unit-test build, extending the root tsconfig.json, adding Jasmine type definitions, and including all *.spec.ts files under src/.

nodes.name: .browserslistrc
nodes.summary: Browserslist configuration specifying browser targets (last Chrome, Firefox, 2 Edge, 2 Safari, 2 iOS, Firefox ESR) for Angular CLI build output compatibility.

nodes.name: karma.conf.js
nodes.summary: Karma test runner configuration wiring Jasmine and Angular DevKit build plugin, Chrome launcher, HTML reporter, and coverage reporting to `./coverage/walk-my-dog`.

nodes.name: .gitkeep
nodes.summary: Empty placeholder file that preserves the src/assets directory in version control.

nodes.name: environment.prod.ts
nodes.summary: Production environment configuration exporting a single `environment` object with `production: true`, used by Angular's build system to swap environment-specific settings at build time.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Root HTML shell for the Angular application, mounting the `<app-root>` component and setting the base href for client-side routing.

nodes.name: polyfills.ts
nodes.summary: Angular CLI-generated polyfills bootstrap file that imports zone.js to enable Angular's change detection, loaded before the application bundle.
nodes.languageNotes: Only imports `zone.js` (a required Angular dependency for change detection); all optional polyfill entries remain commented out, indicating an evergreen-browser target.

nodes.name: styles.css
nodes.summary: Global stylesheet applying a full Meyer CSS reset across all HTML elements and setting `Be Vietnam Pro` as the application-wide font family.

nodes.name: test.ts
nodes.summary: Karma/Jasmine test bootstrap entry point that initialises the Angular testing environment and dynamically loads all `.spec.ts` files in the `src/` tree.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to see what WalkMyDog is: a small Angular 14 dog-walking UI scaffolded by the Angular CLI, run with `ng serve`, built with `ng build`, and tested with `ng test` via Karma.

tour.title: Application Entry Point
tour.description: `main.ts` is where the app boots: it bootstraps the root NgModule (AppModule) in the browser. This is the ignition point for everything that follows.

tour.title: The Root Module
tour.description: AppModule declares the app's components and wires in the router module. It is the composition root that ties the shell, routing, and feature components together.

tour.title: Routing
tour.description: app-routing.module.ts maps URL paths to components — the dogs list and the per-dog detail view — defining how navigation flows through the app.

tour.title: The App Shell
tour.description: AppComponent is the root component whose template hosts the router outlet, so routed views render inside it.

tour.title: The Data Layer: DogsService
tour.description: DogsService is the app's data hub — an in-memory store of dog records that every feature component depends on. It has the highest fan-in in the graph, so understanding its shape unlocks the UI.

tour.title: Listing the Dogs
tour.description: DogsListComponent reads from DogsService and renders the collection, composing a card component per dog.

tour.title: A Single Dog Card
tour.description: DogsListCardComponent is the presentational child used by the list — it displays one dog's summary and is the unit the list repeats.

tour.title: The Detail View
tour.description: DogViewComponent is the routed detail screen: it reads a route index, looks the dog up in DogsService, and renders the full record.

tour.title: Build & Compiler Configuration
tour.description: angular.json defines build/serve/test targets; the tsconfig files govern TypeScript compilation (tsconfig.app and tsconfig.spec both extend the base tsconfig). package.json pins Angular 14 and the npm scripts.

tour.title: Testing & Wrap-Up
tour.description: test.ts is the Karma entry point and karma.conf.js configures the runner; each component/service has a paired .spec.ts. This closes the loop from bootstrap through UI, data, and verification.
